summary: Backend 21/21 pytest pass including: health, settings (shodan_key), mode validation, IP/website/domain E2E, Shodan Search validation (rejects empty & whitespace, accepts 'port:22 product:OpenSSH country:US' preserving spaces), Shodan Search E2E (apache country:NL port:80 returned total=3800+, 50 hits, first hit port=80 product contains 'apache'), HTML report contains 'Shodan Search' heading, IP scan for 1.1.1.1 completes and result.cves field present (empty list, schema-correct), NVD live adapter lookups for Log4Shell (severity=CRITICAL, cvss=10.0, nvd_url, description, published all populated) and Heartbleed (severity=HIGH, cvss=7.5), scoring +15 per CRITICAL CVE capped at +30 for 3 CVEs. Frontend partially verified: 5th Shodan tab (data-testid=tab-shodan_search) shows cyan-highlighted, labeled 'Shodan', placeholder correctly swaps to 'apache country:"US"', Shodan Query Examples card renders with all 5 examples including CVE-2021-44228 Log4Shell, all 4 Skip toggles correctly hidden in shodan_search mode, start-scan-button submits, navigation to /scans/{id} works, ScanProgress shows '09 SEARCH' and '15 CVE' phase steps correctly. HOWEVER: Detail.jsx does NOT render sec-shodan-search or sec-cves sections (see Frontend Issue below).

integration_issues.issue: After a shodan_search scan completes (backend returns result.shodan_search with total=3800+ and 50 hits), the Detail page does NOT display a 'Shodan Search' results section. data-testid='sec-shodan-search' is completely absent from Detail.jsx. User only sees empty Subdomains/Live Hosts/TLS/IP Intel tables — the actual search results are invisible. The only UI feedback is the 'SHODAN_SEARCH scan queued' toast and the completed progress bar.

Detail.jsx does NOT render a sec-cves section. Even when backend populates result.cves with enriched NVD details (description, cvss_score, severity badge, nvd_url, vector, published), the frontend never displays them. The requested CVE cards (sorted by CVSS, clickable nvd.nist.gov links, severity badges color-coded CRITICAL=red / HIGH=orange / MEDIUM=yellow / LOW=green) are not implemented in Detail.jsx.

action_items: Add a <Section icon=Database title='Shodan Search' testId='sec-shodan-search'> block to /app/frontend/src/pages/Detail.jsx that renders when r.shodan_search is truthy. Show r.shodan_search.query, total, and a table of hits with columns: IP:Port, Product (product + version), Org, Country (country_code), Hostnames (join first 3), Banner (truncated).

Add a <Section icon=AlertTriangle title='CVEs' testId='sec-cves'> block to Detail.jsx that renders when r.cves?.length > 0. Sort cves by cvss_score desc. Each card: cve_id as <a href={nvd_url} target='_blank'> link, CVSS score, severity badge with Tailwind color by severity (CRITICAL=risk-critical/red, HIGH=risk-high/orange, MEDIUM=yellow, LOW=risk-low/green), description, optional vector string (monospace), published date.
Consider also adding `sec-shodan-search` section rendering in the HTML report (/app/backend/osint/report.py already has it — verified).
(Minor) iteration_2 note re: deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown still stands.
critical_code_review_comments: Detail.jsx: missing conditional rendering for r.shodan_search and r.cves — backend payload ships these fields but UI ignores them. This means Shodan Search mode and NVD enrichment are 100% unreachable from the UI despite being correctly implemented backend-side.

Scoring (scoring.py): CVE boost scales with *count*, but problem statement implies '+15 per CRITICAL cap 30' — implemented correctly (min(30, 15*n)). HIGH bonus min(15, 5*n) is not in the spec but reasonable.

NVDAdapter uses asyncio.Semaphore(3) — NVD's unauthenticated public rate limit is 5 req / 30s. Under heavy load (30 CVEs) this may still 403. Consider adding per-request sleep or retry-after handling.

success_rate.frontend: 60% — Landing/ScanProgress/submission flow OK, but Detail page missing 2 critical sections (sec-shodan-search + sec-cves) so shodan_search & NVD results never render for the user.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. Focus next iteration on Detail.jsx after main agent adds sec-shodan-search and sec-cves sections. Test selectors to verify: [data-testid='sec-shodan-search'] table rows count ~= total hits (up to 50), first row has IP/Port/Product/Org/CC/Hostnames/Banner columns; [data-testid='sec-cves'] renders after injecting CVE-2021-44228 via an IP scan of a known-vuln host OR by monkeypatching shodan_adapter to return vulns. Shodan search test query 'port:22 product:OpenSSH country:US' completes in ~15-25s. Existing created scans should be cleaned (history contains test scans from this run).
rca_of_the_issue: Main agent implemented the shodan_search + NVD features fully on the backend (models.py, orchestrator.py, nvd_adapter.py, shodan_search.py, report.py, scoring.py, server.py validation) and added the UI entry point (Landing.jsx tab + Shodan query examples + ScanProgress phase labels 'Search'/'CVE'), but forgot to add the consumer render blocks in Detail.jsx. Fix is purely additive: two new <Section> JSX blocks in Detail.jsx (~50 lines total). No backend changes required; API responses already carry r.shodan_search and r.cves.
